npcDefinitions.sql: SELECT npcid,name,classname,note,impl,gfxid FROM p24_world.npc WHERE LOWER(impl) LIKE '%board%' OR LOWER(impl) LIKE '%auction%' OR LOWER(classname) LIKE '%board%' OR LOWER(classname) LIKE '%auction%' OR name LIKE '%公告%' OR name LIKE '%佈告%' OR name LIKE '%拍賣%'

commands.sql: SELECT * FROM p24_world.commands WHERE name IN ('spawn','summon','npc','npcset','killnpc') OR class_name IN ('L1SpawnCmd','L1Summon','L1NpcSet','L1KillNpc')

rows.note: 召喚NPC(參數:NPCID - 數量 - 範圍)

auctionEvents.sql: SELECT * FROM p24_world.server_event WHERE LOWER(eventclass) LIKE '%auction%' OR eventname LIKE '%盟屋%' OR eventname LIKE '%拍賣%'

rows.note: 0關閉1=開；貨幣道具ID,上架手續費;拍賣持續時間(分鐘)

allNpcColumns.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA IN ('p24_world','p24_accounts','p24_lito','p24_cross','p24_transit') AND (LOWER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%npc%' OR COLUMN_NAME IN ('changeto','mob_id')) ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

deathSpawn.sql: SELECT * FROM p24_world.`npc_死亡召喚` WHERE changeto IN (80006,81126,81127,81128,81129,81130,81161,81201)

allActiveBoards.sql: SELECT s.* ,n.classname FROM p24_world.spawnlist_npc s JOIN p24_world.npc n ON n.npcid=s.npc_templateid WHERE s.count>0 AND (LOWER(n.impl) LIKE '%board%' OR n.classname IN ('other.Npc_Board','other.Npc_AuctionBoard'))

auctionSummary.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) total,SUM(deadline>NOW()) unexpired,MIN(deadline) earliest,MAX(deadline) latest,MIN(price) min_price,MAX(price) max_price,SUM(bidder_id=0) no_bidder FROM p24_accounts.`server_盟屋_拍賣`

auctionRegions.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN house_id BETWEEN 262145 AND 262189 THEN '33421,32823' WHEN house_id BETWEEN 327681 AND 327691 THEN '33585,33235' WHEN house_id BETWEEN 458753 AND 458819 THEN '33959,33253' WHEN house_id BETWEEN 524289 AND 524294 THEN '32611,32775' ELSE 'other' END board_xy,COUNT(*) rows_count FROM p24_accounts.`server_盟屋_拍賣` GROUP BY board_xy

clanColumns.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='p24_accounts' AND TABLE_NAME='clan_data'

npcActions.sql: SELECT * FROM p24_world.npcaction WHERE npcid IN (70577,80103,81161,80006)

gmLogCount.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) row_count FROM p24_accounts.`log_GM指令`

spawnIdCandidate.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) row_count FROM p24_world.spawnlist_npc WHERE id=1900251222

bidderCandidates.sql: SELECT c.objid,c.char_name,c.Type,c.level,c.AccessLevel,c.OnlineStatus,c.MapID,c.LocX,c.LocY,d.clan_id,d.clan_name,d.hashouse,d.hascastle FROM p24_accounts.characters c JOIN p24_accounts.clan_data d ON d.leader_id=c.objid WHERE c.Type=0 AND c.level>=15 AND d.hashouse=0

nextGap.sql: SELECT MIN(s.id+1) candidate FROM p24_world.spawnlist_npc s LEFT JOIN p24_world.spawnlist_npc n ON n.id=s.id+1 WHERE n.id IS NULL AND s.id+1<(SELECT MAX(id) FROM p24_world.spawnlist_npc)

tableEngine.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ENGINE,AUTO_INCREMENT FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='p24_world' AND TABLE_NAME='spawnlist_npc'

clock.sql: SELECT NOW() server_now,UTC_TIMESTAMP() utc_now,@@system_time_zone system_time_zone,@@time_zone session_time_zone

charactersFinal.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) total,SUM(AccessLevel<>0) gm,SUM(OnlineStatus<>0) online FROM p24_accounts.characters
